data.turoyo: U ḥa yawmo koḥayrono, kala kmədla li naynəke w kala kmaydola w kosərqo sawka w kogəxxo, hama xd ad daywone.
data.translation: Eines Tages sehe ich, wie sie ihren Spiegel nimmt, ihr Haar kämmt und lacht wie die verrückten.

rationale: New I Infectum box with explicit hair object and feminine subject.

summary: Retain I.1 combing/grooming for both animal and human-hair contexts. Existing II.1 also has hair as object, so participant identity does not establish a stem-specific distinction.
The 2pl -utu in sәrqútuwa supports Infectum-wa rather than Preterit-wa; preserve Cyrillic ә and stress. The comb noun msarqo is not itself a new verbal form.
The existing84/21 quotation is the same event despite its English edition rendering; do not replace it with a new German duplicate.
Confirm the reduced vowel and segmentation of 2pl sәrqútuwa.
Does stem I versus II in hair combing have a dialect or action distinction? These three tokens do not decide.
Correct tool to took in the translation
rationale: Tool is a typo for the past-tense verb took. The supplied translation says nahm ihn mit nach Hause, corresponding to mamṭele l-u=bayto.
